title: The Salt-Frequency Deathless

features.name: the deafened antenna
features.desc-on-touch: this transmission post stopped broadcasting when the salt began to listen. now it hums at a frequency only the air can hear.

features.name: the salt rows learning silence
features.desc-on-touch: salt crystallizes in rows like a monoculture. each crystal is a word the ocean learned to hold instead of speak.

features.name: the frequency-drowning channel
features.desc-on-touch: water here has learned to absorb signals instead of reflect them. the archive stopped transmitting not out of silence, but out of respect.

features.name: the fence of unheard broadcasts
features.desc-on-touch: fence posts mark where signals used to arrive. now they stand in ordered rows, each one a word the country learned to say without speaking.

features.name: the eternal stillness marker
features.desc-on-touch: nothing changes here but the light on salt. the archive chose deafness not as absence but as permanence—a frequency that will never die because it never dies.

inscription: the broadcast stopped not from failure but from learning what silence means to salt

file.name: Transmit_Log_Final_Reception_Coastal.txt
file.note: signal strength records become poetry of diminishment; final entry reads as both transmission log and seaside meditation
